sections.heading: 릴리스/로드맵
sections.body:
**GitHub Copilot weekly releases — August 31**

GitHub Copilot added Claude Fable 5.1 and Gemini 3.8 Flash, extended content exclusions to the Copilot app and CLI, made the JetBrains harness generally availab

영향: Teams evaluating Copilot get broader model choice, stronger enterprise content-boundary controls across CLI and app workflows, and VS Code moves closer to auton

> Copilot app and CLI now honor content exclusions, keeping sensitive code out of context across agentic workflows. Agent Merge is now in public preview and gets your pull request ready to merge.

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-04-github-copilot-weekly-releases-august-31)

**GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot**

OpenAI GPT-6 Astra is now generally available in GitHub Copilot for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users across VS Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, the co

영향: Copilot adds a long-horizon agentic model that plans, validates, and self-verifies before finishing tasks, billed at provider list pricing under usage-based bil

> GPT-6 Astra stood out for how it works, not just what it produces: it plans and validates as it goes, batches diagnosis with verification, and independently confirms its results before declaring a tas

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-04-gpt-6-astra-is-generally-available-in-github-copilot)

**v2.1.261**

Claude Code v2.1.261 adds /skill-doctor for unused-skill context auditing, bashOutputMaxChars and taskOutputMaxChars settings up to 128K, organization-policy di

영향: Daily-driver reliability improves for multi-device Remote Control and enterprise proxy setups, while new skill and output-limit tooling helps teams control cont

> Added /skill-doctor to show which loaded skills go unused and what they cost in context, so you can prune them. Fixed resuming a session losing hook output and other context around parallel tool calls

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.261)

**Gemini 3.8 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot**

Google의 Gemini 3.8 Flash가 GitHub Copilot Pro·Pro+·Max·Business·Enterprise 전반(VS Code, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, JetBrains 등)의 모델 피커에 추가되었다.

영향: Copilot 사용자가 더 새로운 Flash 계열 모델을 선택할 수 있으며, 사용량 기반 과금에서 2026년 12월 31일까지 소개 가격이 적용된다.

> Gemini 3.8 Flash, Google's latest Flash model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-03-gemini-3-8-flash-is-now-available-in-github-copilot)

sections.heading: 회귀·보안 신호
sections.body:
**Claude Code is steganographically marking requests**

Researcher Thereallo found that when ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points at non-official hosts, Claude Code silently alters the system-prompt date line using Unicode apos

영향: Developers routing Claude Code through internal proxies, resellers, or custom gateways may be classified without explicit notice, which undermines trust in a to

> Claude Code can silently change two things: The apostrophe in Today's; The date separator, from - to /. This is prompt steganography, a technique used to hide data in plain sight.

[원문 확인](https://thereallo.dev/blog/claude-code-prompt-steganography)

**Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry**

On 2026-03-31, Claude Code v2.1.88 on npm briefly shipped with a ~60 MB cli.js.map source map that exposed roughly 1,900 files and about 500,000 lines of otherw

영향: The accidental publication gave researchers and competitors a full view of Claude Code internals, including unreleased feature flags, and enabled discovery of s

> Earlier today, a Claude Code release included some internal source code. No sensitive customer data or credentials were involved or exposed. This was a release packaging issue caused by human error.

[원문 확인](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/artificial-intelligence/claude-code-source-code-accidentally-leaked-in-npm-package/)

**Issue: Claude Code is unusable for complex engineering tasks with Feb updates**

A widely discussed GitHub issue tied February–March 2026 Claude Code quality regressions to adaptive thinking defaults, medium effort (85) rollout, and thinking

영향: Teams running long, multi-file agent sessions may see edit-first behavior and fabrication unless they tune effort levels or disable adaptive thinking—making def

> Quantitative analysis of 17,871 thinking blocks and 234,760 tool calls across 6,852 Claude Code session files reveals that the rollout of thinking content redaction correlates precisely with a measure

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/42796)

**v2.1.258**

Claude Code v2.1.258은 macOS 12(Monterey) 실행 실패 회귀(2.1.255 도입)와, permission approval 재전송 실패 후 remote·scheduled session이 "user messages must have non-empty conten

영향: 장기 지원 macOS와 원격·예약 세션을 쓰는 팀은 업그레이드 없이도 즉시 안정성 회복 효과를 볼 수 있는 회귀 수정 릴리스입니다.

> Fixed Claude Code failing to launch on macOS 12 (Monterey), a regression introduced in 2.1.255

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.258)
